cases.title: Installer validation precedes copying
cases.lesson: Reject malformed arguments and destination type conflicts before copying files, so a rejected install does not partly overwrite an existing skill.
cases.invariant: The POSIX installer regression suite passes, including argument validation, preservation of personal files, and unchanged destinations after type conflicts.

applicability.when: Changing installer argument parsing, copying, destination preflight, or the packaged skill directory structure.

sources.note: Executable regression checks create only isolated temporary installs.
Review documenting the argument and partial-update defects.

argv: import os, unittest; os.environ['FABLE_TEST_SHELL'] = 'sh'; suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests', pattern='test_install.py'); result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite); raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun > 0 and not result.skipped else 1)

cases.title: Distribution checks reject drift and preserve existing archives
cases.lesson: Validate package membership, links, file types, and staged output before replacing an archive; a successful build alone cannot demonstrate that a checked-in archive matches source.
cases.invariant: The package regression suite passes, including drift detection, unsafe member rejection, reproducibility, and preservation of an existing archive after invalid builds.

applicability.when: Changing package validation, archive assembly, source-link validation, or archive replacement.

sources.note: Regression suite builds fixture archives under temporary directories.
Current package and reference validation implementation.
